description: IRexp Scientific Data Technical Validation QC package

n200.note: Enlarged sample; Europe PMC full-text re-fetch; ±1 cm⁻¹ integer match

extraction_recall_proxy.method: Automatic recall proxy on the harvest path: re-fetch PMC-OA S3 plain text (fallback Europe PMC XML); re-run extract_records; compare IR band-sets to released IRexp rows for the same PMCID (±1 cm⁻¹). Not a human recall audit.

structure_nmr_consistency_sample.method: Comma/semicolon-split 13C δ tokens (leading float in [-10,235]); RDKit carbon/hydrogen counts; 1H integrals from (nH) patterns

structure_nmr_quarantine_full_resolved.description: Full-corpus structure–NMR/IR consistency quarantine on irexp_resolved
structure_nmr_quarantine_full_resolved.method: parse_h_peaks/parse_c_peaks on author strings; RDKit C/H counts; fail if 13C peak count > carbons, or 1H integral sum > formula H+2, or any IR band outside [350,4000] cm-1, or SMILES unparseable
structure_nmr_quarantine_full_resolved.note: Quarantine is diagnostic — release files are unchanged. Re-users should filter these IDs before supervised training.

harvest_provenance.discovery: NCBI esearch with open access[filter] + IR characterisation query; not a walk of oa_comm/oa_noncomm package trees
harvest_provenance.fetch: s3://pmc-oa-opendata flat keys PMC{id}.{v}/PMC{id}.{v}.txt via HTTPS
harvest_provenance.licence_alignment: Post-hoc Europe PMC licence join (scripts/join_pmc_licences.py) segregates commercial vs NC vs empty/unknown; equivalent intent to oa_comm vs oa_noncomm but applied at article licence field, not S3 package directory
